Chaos!.desc: Random Number Generator (RNG) decides the outcome of what spawns, be sure to keep an eye out for any node spawn from it.

Pure Pandemonium.desc: All node entities became Pandemonium, so don't try using Safe Spots.

3AM Challenge.desc: Witching Hour will follow you throughout the entire run, look at it to keep it away temporarily.

Interloper.desc: Lopee follows you everywhere, you must keep going. On contact of him, you'll die instantly.

Not For Broadcast.desc: The music begins after the airlock at Door 0, starting a countdown of 4 minutes and 43 seconds. The timer appears at 4 minutes and 20 seconds and ends when the first button at the end of The Ridge is pressed.

Rat Race.desc: When the first door is opened, you start with 50 researches. Every step you take will cost you a research, any collected researches are shared across players, but doesn't reduce on all players. If you have none, you take damage for every step. The collected research is also increased by 50% automatically.

Noodle Legs.desc: Any damage you took (including from items like SPR-INT) will ragdoll you, worst case scenario is being forced to stare at an Eyefestation without options.

Lock In.desc: Dying before door 50 nullifies the bonuses of all modifiers and reduces rewards by 75%

All Or Nothing.desc: Dying at all nullifies the bonuses of all modifiers and reduced rewards by 75%.
